cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: The Logic Gets Bigger
cards.instruction: Use every new detail to expand the impossible system, its history, and the consequences of breaking it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our soup bowl said hello. Use the formal greeting; crockery stopped speaking after the Great Washing-Up.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Trade has reopened. I'll fetch a roll; keep the butter separate. Mixed gifts caused the gravy embargo.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's asking for a seat at dinner.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A seat makes it a nation. I'll give it mine; move the plates apart before it claims their territory.
